verdict_text: NO. The script delegates checkpoint loading and the entire sharded export to `load_checkpoint` and `save_sharded_safetensors` from an unshown module `_ckpt`, which is not part of the artifact and is not one of the packages available in the sandbox, so the script cannot be verified to run and the sharding requirements of clause 4 (512 MiB shard cap on tensor data, oversized embeddings alone in their own shard, an index file `model.safetensors.index.json` with a complete `weight_map`) are not demonstrably implemented. The merge arithmetic (float32 `scale * B @ A` added and cast back to float16, adapter tensors excluded) and the four required checks are otherwise correct, but the checks run before writing as required only if `_ckpt` exists at all. As written, the artifact does not standalone-satisfy the "Required result" clause 4.
